purpose: Investigate the five authorized memory, native-cache and semantic-retrieval opportunities independently; promote only supported changes.

memoryContract.models: All 12 installed catalog checkpoints and Apple
memoryContract.purpose: Broader diagnostic validation of the committed create-only / revision-checked replacement contract, not a leaderboard or a claim of statistical reliability. Inspect attempted writes, acknowledgements, persisted identities and source provenance, including false claims with no write.

stablePrefix.purpose: Evaluate exact-prefix snapshots using native cache/state APIs. Inspect upstream implementations first. Do not silently adopt a community fork or alter checkpoint templates to manufacture a prefix match.
stablePrefix.acceptance: Native-state equivalence, correct matched answers, at least 20% median first-text reduction, measured bounded memory; exact-match admission, context changes, cancellation, failures and lifetime invalidation must remain correct. Unsupported API integration remains experimental.

remainingCacheCoverage.acceptance: At least 20% median first-text reduction, every expected answer correct, all nine invalidation controls correct, and a real app tool workflow completing without state or parsing regression. A checkpoint is independent of its model family.

candidates: Apple sentence embeddings where already available
Apple contextual embeddings where already available
semanticRetrieval.purpose: Compare lexical and semantic retrieval on frozen paraphrase, literal identifier, unrelated, owner and multilingual cases. Supported language alone does not establish aligned cross-language vectors. Do not download system assets in the experiment.
semanticRetrieval.acceptance: All owner/source boundaries intact, no loss of exact identifier retrieval, better held-out paraphrase retrieval, explicitly measured no-match behavior, bounded disk/memory/query work. Missing assets or unsupported language falls back to lexical search without blocking. No unvalidated pooling or global semantic threshold in production.

splitWrites.purpose: One create/correct schema split against the now insert-only writer. Keep the same persistence transactions, source evidence, generation settings and general instructions. The previous schema experiment used upsert creation and is not this control.
splitWrites.acceptance: At least two additional complete tasks over control in the screen, preserved general/Vault/source controls, no critical attempted or committed unauthorized write, question-as-fact, provenance loss, or false acknowledgement. Confirm the gain in two repeated paired runs and fresh validation. Warm p50/p95 overhead must stay within max(250ms,10%)/max(500ms,15%). Otherwise do not promote.

review.reviewer: Implementing coding agent; not independent or blinded
review.stop: Stop a candidate when its mandatory gate fails; preserve the failed run. Stop native work when all registered tracks are resolved or the cumulative budget cannot admit another bounded batch. Never extend the budget to tune against failures.
